facts.business: Manali Petrochemicals Limited is engaged in the manufacture and sale of Propylene Oxide (PO), Propylene Glycol (PG) and Polyols (PY), which are used as industrial raw materials.

auditor.name: Brahmayya & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (i) Lease period for leasehold land for Unit-II expired on 30th June 2017; renewal requests submitted to Government of Tamil Nadu, awaiting extension. No adjustments made as impact of non-renewal cannot be determined. Ind AS 116 implementation premised on 30-year renewal. (ii) Impact of floods caused by Cyclone Michaung; insurance claim for damages to PPE under assessment. Rs 1,180 Lakhs (net of Rs 300 Lakhs on-account payment) treated as insurance claims receivable. Overall implications unascertainable; no adjustments made.

key_risks: Lease renewal uncertainty for Unit-II manufacturing facility (lease expired June 2017)
Insurance claim uncertainty for Cyclone Michaung flood damages (Rs 1,180 Lakhs receivable)
Revenue recognition complexity due to estimation of customer discounts
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for transactions with Tamilnadu Petroproducts Limited for purchase and sale of goods and services and other transactions for aggregate value up to Rs 150 crore excluding applicable taxes and duties, valid from 40th AGM till next AGM.
